scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT "npm run dev -w @idle/server" "npm run dev -w @idle/client"
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @idle/client && esbuild apps/server/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:express --external:socket.io --external:@prisma/client --external:@prisma/adapter-libsql --external:dotenv --external:dotenv/config --outfile=apps/server/dist/index.js
